name: Ping mapping
description: What a ping request writes: the Ping record, and the Check fields it moves.
records: remote address -> Ping.remote_addr: client IP, X-Forwarded-For aware
request scheme -> Ping.scheme: http or https
request method -> Ping.method: GET, POST or HEAD
request body -> Ping.body_raw: stored in the row, or in S3 when over 100 bytes
URL action (start, fail, log, exit status) -> Ping.kind: success pings keep no kind
exit status in URL -> Ping.exitstatus: a non-zero status counts as fail
run id (rid) -> Ping.rid: pairs a start with its end
Check.n_pings -> Ping.n: incremented under a row lock
Check.alert_after -> Check.alert_after: recomputed by going_down_after after each ping
